bad_request_graded.reason: a malformed request (missing prompt) answers 400/500 with an error body

completion_deterministic.reason: a byte-identical second request returns the same completion text (temperature 0, fixed seed)

completion_envelope.reason: POST /v1/completions answers 200 object=text_completion with a choices[0].text string

completion_model_id.reason: completion model echoes --alias, not the file path

completion_timings.reason: timings.predicted_n equals usage.completion_tokens with a numeric predicted_ms

completion_usage.reason: usage carries integer token counts that sum

hold_released.reason: the release file appeared inside the hold window

listener_owned.reason: first-answer listener on 36561 owned by child 1852229

model_digest.reason: sha256 of --model equals the pinned fixture digest

models_alias_id.reason: the /v1/models data[].id list is exactly the --alias value

server_digest.reason: sha256 of llama-server equals the pinned release digest

teardown_clean.reason: SIGTERM teardown returned rc=0 in 3 ms

teardown_port_closed.reason: no listener remains on the run port
